criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark register; 1, 2 and 9 pass most of the stage test, 9 the best. Frame 3 does not read as a car in the creek at 432 px: a cropped slab on a black plane, no brown water or ledge, a brown block at right. Frame 5's instances read as tiles. Frame 6's car floats on dark struts. Frame 8's window car reads as a toy on a shelf. Frame 4's water is a flat dark rectangle above a green strip. Frame 7's lit posts don't separate visibly.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck: one world, one car, comal reserved for the water line, one chassis, a dark track; two devices work. Frame 8 and the aerials on 5 and 7 sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; 177 re-derived; the day-first May 1st reading supported. Frame 4's mechanics lean on TPR quoting the notice; frame 8's Model field is not quoted by a claim.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and where land; the action thin with 26E026 only in the first comment; no Texas body; the April 20th coincidence unaddressed; c23 unused.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; frame 2 steps back; 3 a real turn; 6 and 7 cover ground already given; the close lands.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Texas specific and honest; 'Drawn to illustrate.' boilerplate; frame 5's dek explains the drawing.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh world; same city, hazard and night look as no. 50 four days ago; one post per day repeats recent decks.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 3 so a reader sees the car to its beltline in brown rippled floodwater against lit limestone banks.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Does not read as a flood; cropped slab on a black plane; a brown block reads as furniture.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A lit rippled brown surface at the beltline with broken highlights, delete the block, light a limestone bank behind.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The window car reads as a toy on a shelf.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A visible window frame with the car small and distant under its own lamp, or drop it and crop tighter.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The car hovers on dark struts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat the body on lit tyres with contact at the water's edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Glassless loaf instances read as tiles.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A silhouette with a dark glass band and arches; a lower camera.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lit and unlit posts look the same.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pool the key only over the 177 posts from the ring to the car.
